items.title: Snapshot Pro Rollout Might Change The Case For Investing In Progressive (PGR)
items.summary: Progressive completed the rollout of Snapshot Pro, a unified commercial telematics program that merges Snapshot ProView and Smart Haul, gives customers multiple device options, and ties driving behavior to potential premium savings at renewal. The broader access to driving dashboards, safety ratings, and trip data gives Progressive a richer view of commercial risk that can influence underwriting decisions and operational coaching for small fleets and owner operators.
